│                                                                          │
│  ---                                                                     │
│                                                                          │
│  ### Phase 1: Planning and Research                                      │
│                                                                          │
│  **Objective:**                                                          │
│  Define the scope, goals, and requirements of the 2FA implementation.    │
│                                                                          │
│  **Steps:**                                                              │
│  1. **Stakeholder Identification and Input Collection**                  │
│     - Identify key stakeholders including IT Security team, User         │
│  Experience team, and Legal department.                                  │
│     - Schedule meetings to gather inputs from each stakeholder.          │
│                                                                          │
│  2. **Research and Benchmarking**                                        │
│     - Research different 2FA methods (e.g., SMS codes, Authenticator     │
│  apps, hardware tokens).                                                 │
│     - Evaluate existing security practices in other industries for best  │
│  practices.                                                              │
│     - Document findings and create a preliminary report.                 │
│                                                                          │
│  **Timeline:**                                                           │
│  - Complete within 1 week                                                │
│                                                                          │
│  **Skills Needed:**                                                      │
│  - Project management skills                                             │
│  - Research and analysis skills                                          │
│  - Stakeholder communication and coordination                            │
│                                                                          │
│  ---                                                                     │
│                                                                          │
│  ### Phase 2: Design and Prototyping                                     │
│                                                                          │
│  **Objective:**                                                          │
│  Develop a detailed design for the 2FA system and create prototypes for  │
│  testing.                                                                │
│                                                                          │
│  **Steps:**                                                              │
│  1. **Design Document Creation**                                         │
│     - Draft technical and functional requirements for the 2FA system.    │
│     - Create diagrams to visualize the integration process with your     │
│  existing systems (e.g., database tables, API endpoints).                │
│                                                                          │
│  2. **Prototyping**                                                      │
│     - Develop low-fidelity prototypes of user flows for both signing up  │
│  and logging in with 2FA.                                                │
│     - Test these prototypes internally to gather feedback from a small   │
│  group.                                                                  │
│                                                                          │
│  **Timeline:**                                                           │
│  - Complete within 1 week                                                │
│                                                                          │
│  **Skills Needed:**                                                      │
│  - Technical writing and documentation skills                            │
│  - Prototyping tools (e.g., Axure, Figma)                                │
│  - User experience design principles                                     │
│                                                                          │
│  ---                                                                     │

│  testing.                                                                │
│                                                                          │
│  **Steps:**                                                              │
│  1. **Code Development**                                                 │
│     - Implement the designed features into your application or           │
│  platform.                                                               │
│     - Ensure that all necessary integrations (e.g., with SMS gateway,    │
│  authenticator app APIs) are set up correctly.                           │
│                                                                          │
│  2. **Testing and Validation**                                           │
│     - Conduct unit tests and integration tests to ensure code quality.   │
│     - Perform security testing to identify vulnerabilities.              │
│     - Deploy the system to a controlled environment for user groups to   │
│  test.                                                                   │
│                                                                          │
│  **Timeline:**                                                           │
│  - Complete within 3 weeks                                               │
│                                                                          │

│  - Strong coding skills (e.g., Python, JavaScript)                       │
│  - Knowledge of relevant web standards and protocols                     │
│  - Experience with security testing tools and practices                  │
│                                                                          │
│  ---                                                                     │
│                                                                          │

│                                                                          │
